title: Fix RFC 4180 edge cases in the CSV parser and writer
prompt: Our little CSV module (src/csv.mjs) breaks on real exports. parseCSV mangles quoted fields that contain doubled quotes (""), leaves stray \r characters when the file uses CRLF line endings, can't cope with a quoted field that spans several lines, and silently drops the last record when it ends with an empty field (e.g. `a,b,` with no trailing newline). An unterminated quoted field should throw instead of returning garbage. A single trailing line break at the end of the input must not create an extra empty record. stringifyCSV has the mirror-image problems: it should quote a field whenever it contains the delimiter, a double quote, CR or LF (doubling embedded quotes), render null/undefined as empty fields, and join records with CRLF (no trailing line break), so that parseCSV(stringifyCSV(rows)) gives back the same rows. Both functions take an optional { delimiter } (default ','). Please fix it; `node --test "test/*.test.mjs"` must pass.
